passages.context: The exact image visibly places the rubricated exorcist-ordination unit after the reader blessing and before acolyte ordination. It directs episcopal delivery of a booklet containing exorcisms and includes a spoken commission and prayer. This is one manuscript witness whose bounded architecture may be compared with the edited PRG, not an archetype, critical edition, proof of textual relationship or direct descent, evidence of performance or frequency, current law, or modern major-exorcism practice.
